testcase.name: temporary host inactivity does not become a destination Back policy
protected navigation is rejected until the session is unlocked and activated
onboarding rejects external navigation without retaining a pending destination
malformed route arguments are rejected before entering a live stack
every static external intent builds its documented owning stack
process-restored protected stacks remain quarantined behind authentication
push pop and single top are deterministic
default back disposition distinguishes pop local tab return and application exit
locking quarantines stacks and unlock restores only the supplied validated snapshot
new external input supersedes an older pending validation without stale mutation
inactive lifecycle and stale route tokens cannot navigate
rapid repeated tab input cannot turn a switch into an accidental reselect
onboarding navigation is separate and resetting onboarding discards protected restoration
host detachment immediately rejects navigation from the former active entry
route ownership is enforced by the navigator rather than adapters
pushing an existing route pops to it instead of duplicating it
validated external navigation waits while host is inactive and applies once resumed
tab stacks are isolated and reselect pops only the selected tab to root
external credential navigation is auth gated and builds a deterministic stack
